findings.title: Review Rating Distribution (Analysis Period)
findings.claim: During 2026-02-23T00:00:00+03:00 to 2026-03-02T00:00:00+03:00, reviews averaged 4.50 stars across 10 reviews from sources: google, instagram, talabat.
assumptions: Rating values are numeric and valid
Date field is accurate and in UTC+3
All reviews in artifact are from the specified sources

findings.title: Review Language Distribution
findings.claim: Of 10 reviews in the analysis period, 9 are in English and 1 are in Arabic.
coverage_notes: Bilingual coverage enables sentiment analysis in both languages
assumptions: Language field accurately reflects review language
Reviews are classified as either 'en' or 'ar'

findings.title: Review Sentiment Distribution (Non-Empty Reviews)
findings.claim: Of 10 non-empty reviews in the analysis period, sentiment analysis indicates 3 positive, 1 negative, and 6 neutral/mixed sentiments.
coverage_notes: Sentiment classification based on keyword matching in review text
Both English and Arabic reviews included in analysis
assumptions: Sentiment keywords are representative of positive/negative intent
Keyword matching is a proxy for sentiment (not a trained model)
Reviews with both positive and negative keywords are classified as neutral/mixed
Empty or whitespace-only reviews are excluded from sentiment analysis
